title: 第7章 不是我怎么就可爱了第8章 你给我的备注咋老这么长
slug: 掌门师伯新收了个女徒弟
content_zh:
因为没有多余的蒲团，周清只好找了一处角落坐下，静静等待。
环顾四周，皆是清一色的白衣。
看来此番这位石蓁师姐授课的内容全都关乎凝气的，否则内门和真传指不定也会来的。
不久后，一名穿着天蓝色长袍，眉如远黛，神色清冷的女子自前方出现。
众人连忙起身行礼。
石蓁点了点头，随后坐下，没有多余的废话，直接进入主题。
“今日所要讲的便是《青木御灵盾》，是一种以木属性灵气为基础的防御型功法，是我太清门上到核心，下到外门必学之术，毕竟任何时候，只有活着，才有机会谈及其他。”
石蓁说完，随着心神一动，一股浓郁的木属性灵气猛然间从四面八方涌来，如同受到召唤一般，瞬间在她周围凝聚。
只是眨眼间，一个坚实的护盾便是成型，表面纹理清晰，充满了坚固感。
这一幕看得众人惊叹不已，毕竟他们就算勉强施展，也需要各种口诀和结印。
哪像石蓁师姐这般，简直就是一个念头的事。
周清同样感叹，他可做不到如此得心应手，若面对强敌，需得拉开一定距离，给自个施展的时间。
否则还没成型呢，人家就已经到了你跟前。
石蓁散去木盾，开始了讲解：“木韵悠悠，灵息涌流，气贯乾坤，灵引四方，这句口诀其实换个思路，我们可以理解成……”
台下的周清听得很认真，对同一种功法，每个人都有自己独到的理解。
【忽略点+1】
【忽略点+1】
…………
接下来三天时间，周清不断来往各个峰的【讲道厅】，进行刷点，虽然慢一些，但胜在积少成多。
而就在今天，天赋技能【降低存在感】终于满级，升到了lv2。

不光如此，他惊喜地发现，在自己听课睡着时，竟不知何时又多出来一枚技能碎片。
【技能碎片：33（可获得）】
“获取。”
激动之下，周清连忙进行合成。
技能碎片这边瞬间清零，可获得变成了不可获得。
很快，一条信息就此出现在脑海。
【天赋技能——心鉴之视：可以看到他人内心对宿主的备注，目前等级可绑定三人。】
【随着等级提升，绑定的人数也会相应增加。】
【改变绑定对象对宿主的看法，可获得不同程度的心鉴点。】
周清眨眨眼，总算是理解了新的天赋技能，感觉好有趣。
随着心神一动，面板出现。
【姓名：周清】
【年龄：十九】
【修为：筑基初期】
【功法：太清玄气诀】
【天赋技能：心鉴之视——lv1（0100）、
降低存在感——lv2（1100）】
【技能碎片：03（不可获得）】
content_en:
Because there was no extra futon, Zhou Qing had to find a corner to sit down and wait quietly.
Looking around, they are all dressed in white.
It seems that the content taught by Senior Sister Shi Zhen this time is all about Qi Condensation, otherwise the inner sect and the true disciples might also come.
Not long after, a woman wearing a sky-blue robe, eyebrows as dark as black, and a cold expression appeared from the front.
Everyone quickly stood up and saluted.
Shi Zhen nodded, then sat down and went directly to the topic without any unnecessary nonsense.
"What I'm going to talk about today is the "Aoki Spiritual Shield". It is a defensive technique based on wood-attribute spiritual energy. It is a technique that my Taiqing Sect must learn from the core to the outer sect. After all, at any time, as long as you are alive, you have the opportunity to talk about other things."
After Shi Zhen finished speaking, as her mind moved, a strong wood-attribute spiritual energy suddenly surged from all directions, and instantly condensed around her as if being summoned.
In just the blink of an eye, a solid shield was formed, with clear surface texture and a sense of solidity.
Everyone was amazed at this scene. After all, even if they could barely perform it, they still needed various formulas and seals.
Unlike Senior Sister Shi Zhen, it was just a thought.
Zhou Qing also lamented that he could not be so handy. If he faced a strong enemy, he would have to keep a certain distance to give himself time to perform.
Otherwise, people will already be in front of you before it even takes shape.
Shi Zhen dismissed the wooden shield and began to explain: "The wood rhymes, the spiritual breath flows, the energy flows through the universe, and the spirit guides the four directions. In fact, if we change the idea, we can understand it as..."
Zhou Qing in the audience listened very carefully. Everyone has their own unique understanding of the same exercise.
[Ignore point +1]
[Ignore point +1]
…………
In the next three days, Zhou Qing kept going back and forth to the [Lecture Hall] of each peak to brush up points. Although it was slower, the victory was in accumulating less and making more.
And just today, the talent skill [Reduce Sense of Presence] finally reached its full level and reached level 2.
Not only that, he was pleasantly surprised to find that when he fell asleep during the lecture, another skill fragment unexpectedly appeared.
[Skill fragments: 33 (obtainable)]
"Get."
Excited, Zhou Qing hurriedly synthesized it.
The skill fragments are cleared instantly, and the obtainable becomes unobtainable.
Soon, a piece of information appeared in my mind.
[Innate skill - Heart's Vision: You can see other people's inner comments about the host. The current level can bind three people. 】
[As the level increases, the number of people bound will also increase accordingly. 】
[Changing the bound object's view of the host can obtain different levels of insights. 】
Zhou Qing blinked and finally understood the new talent skills. It felt so interesting.
With a thought, the panel appeared.
[Name: Zhou Qing]
[Age: Nineteen]
[Cultivation: Early stage of foundation building]
[Kung Fu: Tai Qing Xuan Qi Jue]
[Talent skill: Insight - lv1 (0100),
Reduce the sense of presence——lv2 (1100)]
[Skill Fragments: 03 (unobtainable)]
